title: Lighter Filipino Chicken Adobo Meal Prep Bowls
hook: Meal prep Monday: Filipino chicken adobo. One pot, 4 lunches, better by Wednesday
benefit: Lean protein with fiber from brown rice and green beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, trimmed
1/3 cup white vinegar (or apple cider vinegar)
1 tsp whole black peppercorns (or 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper)
key_ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, 1 lb green beans
steps: Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and peppercorns in a bowl and let it marinate 15 minutes (or overnight). Meanwhile start the rice: 1 cup brown rice, 2 cups water, covered, on low for 40 to 45 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large pot or deep skillet over medium-high. Lift the chicken out of the marinade (keep the marinade) and sear 3 minutes per side until browned. Add the onion and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the marinade and the water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes.
Uncover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes more, until the sauce reduces to a glaze and the chicken reaches 165F inside. Taste and stir in the sugar or honey if you like it a touch sweeter.
Steam the green beans in a skillet with 1/4 cup water, covered, for 4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.

Divide the rice between 4 containers, top with the chicken and sauce, add the green beans, scallions and a lime wedge. Keeps 4 days in the fridge; reheat 90 seconds. The flavor gets better by day two.
vo_steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and peppercorns while the rice cooks.
Sear the chicken three minutes a side, then add the onion.
Pour in the marinade and water, cover and simmer twenty minutes.
Uncover and simmer ten more minutes until the sauce turns to a glaze.
Steam the green beans four minutes.
Pack rice, chicken and beans into four containers. Keeps four days.
